metaDescription: Photos of World Touch tourist buses on Kathmandu–Pokhara and Kathmandu–Chitwan routes, vehicle rentals, and Himalayan treks and tours from our Kathmandu desk.
heroAlt: World Touch tourist coach on a scenic highway in Nepal
intro: A quick look at how we move guests around Nepal — daily tourist coaches, private hires, and the treks and tours those roads connect to.
All photos are from World Touch operations and partner routes we book from Thamel. For seat reservations or rental dates, contact our desk — we reply with availability, not a generic brochure.
